name: Shia Islam
line: Shia Muslims worship one God, Allah, follow the Quran and the Prophet Muhammad, and look to the Prophet's family, the Imams, for guidance.
summary: Shia Muslims believe in one God, Allah, and that Muhammad is God's messenger, who brought the Quran. They believe God chose Ali, the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law, and then a line of Imams from the Prophet's family to guide the faithful. Most Shia, called Twelvers, follow twelve Imams. They believe the twelfth Imam, the Mahdi, is hidden and will return to bring justice before the Last Day. While he is hidden, trusted scholars guide believers on matters of law. Shia Muslims honor the Prophet's grandson Husayn, who died at Karbala, and remember him each year on Ashura.
beliefs: There is one God, Allah, who is just, and Muhammad is His messenger.
God chose Imams from the Prophet's family, starting with Ali, to guide people.
The hidden twelfth Imam, the Mahdi, will return to bring justice.
Jesus is a great prophet of God, not God.
On the Last Day the dead will rise and be judged by their deeds.
practices: Pray the five daily prayers, often joined at three times of day.
Fast from dawn to sunset in the month of Ramadan.
Remember Imam Husayn on Ashura with sermons, poems and gatherings.
Follow the guidance of a trusted religious scholar on questions of law.
Make the pilgrimage to Mecca if able, and visit holy places such as Karbala.

followers.value: Between 162 and 211 million worldwide, about 10 to 13% of Muslims
